lead: `peek.py --locate` takes symbol names only and answers one line per file, so a name two `impl` blocks in one file share resolves silently to the first one.
body: `--locate set_peer crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/inbound.rs` reports `Inbound::set_peer` at `:600` and never `InboundSpec::set_peer` at `:1227`, and it reads the path as a second *symbol* — printing `NOT FOUND` for it rather than scoping the search — while a `file.rs:@Type::method` target answers "no definition or mention" for a method that is right there. For a name a file carries twice, one `grep -n 'fn <name>' <file>` names both and is the only form that does.
